the-quiet-harbor.name: The Quiet Harbor
the-quiet-harbor.about: Drama series. A harbour master inherits a town's secrets along with its tide tables. Two seasons.

rollback.name: Rollback
rollback.about: Thriller series. A release engineer discovers that every deploy is rewriting more than the servers. One season.

second-kitchen.name: Second Kitchen
second-kitchen.about: Comedy series. Two rival food trucks share one generator and, eventually, one kitchen.

northlight-originals.name: Northlight Originals
northlight-originals.about: Documentaries and docuseries. Long shots, real people, cold places.

halfmoon-pictures.name: Halfmoon Pictures
halfmoon-pictures.about: Feature films from an independent studio, now streaming.

paper-lantern-studio.name: Paper Lantern Studio
paper-lantern-studio.about: Animated features and shorts for everyone, drawn by hand.

late-lines.name: Late Lines
late-lines.about: Stand-up specials recorded after midnight in small rooms.

signal-lost.name: Signal Lost
signal-lost.about: Science fiction anthology. Every episode is a different transmission.

quiet-harbor-s1e1.title: The Quiet Harbor S1:E1 "High Water"
quiet-harbor-s1e1.description: Mara Lindqvist returns to Skarholm to bury her father and discovers the harbour master's office has been keeping two sets of tide tables. 52 min. TV-14.

comments.author: carol
comments.text: The tide table reveal in the last two minutes had me pausing to rewind.

comments.author: bob
comments.text: settled in for the whole season after this one

quiet-harbor-s1e2.title: The Quiet Harbor S1:E2 "The Ledger"
quiet-harbor-s1e2.description: Mara finds the second ledger. The town council would like it back. 49 min. TV-14.

comments.author: alice
comments.text: Two ledgers, one truth. The show knows what it is doing.

quiet-harbor-s1e3.title: The Quiet Harbor S1:E3 "Neap"
quiet-harbor-s1e3.description: The lowest tide in a decade exposes the wreck everyone has been quiet about. 55 min. TV-14.

comments.author: bob
comments.text: the wreck shot is the best thing on the service right now

quiet-harbor-s2e1.title: The Quiet Harbor S2:E1 "Spring Tide"
quiet-harbor-s2e1.description: Season two opens six months later. Mara is the harbour master now, and the ledgers are hers to keep. 58 min. TV-14.

comments.author: carol
comments.text: Season two in one sitting. No regrets, some sleep loss.

rollback-s1e1.title: Rollback S1:E1 "Canary"
rollback-s1e1.description: Release engineer Dev Okafor notices that a canary deploy changed a colleague's memory of the standup. 47 min. TV-MA.

comments.author: alice
comments.text: A deploy that rewrites the past. As a release engineer I feel seen and threatened.

comments.author: carol
comments.text: the standup scene is uncomfortably accurate

rollback-s1e2.title: Rollback S1:E2 "Blue-Green"
rollback-s1e2.description: Two versions of the office run at once. Dev has to decide which one to route traffic to. 45 min. TV-MA.

comments.author: bob
comments.text: blue-green deployment as a horror premise. incredible.

rollback-s1e3.title: Rollback S1:E3 "Point of No Return"
rollback-s1e3.description: The rollback window closes in twelve minutes. Dev has a checklist and no one left who remembers writing it. 51 min. TV-MA.

comments.author: carol
comments.text: twelve minutes. they did their research.

comments.author: alice
comments.text: The checklist is the hero of the episode.

second-kitchen-s1e1.title: Second Kitchen S1:E1 "One Generator"
second-kitchen-s1e1.description: Two rival food trucks discover they have been sharing an extension cord for a year. 24 min. TV-PG.

comments.author: bob
comments.text: the extension cord reveal is a perfect cold open

second-kitchen-s1e2.title: Second Kitchen S1:E2 "Health Inspection"
second-kitchen-s1e2.description: The inspector arrives while both trucks are mid-lunch rush and mid-argument. 23 min. TV-PG.

comments.author: carol
comments.text: I laughed so hard at the clipboard bit I had to pause

second-kitchen-s1e3.title: Second Kitchen S1:E3 "The Merger"
second-kitchen-s1e3.description: One kitchen, two menus, zero agreement on the name. 22 min. TV-PG.

comments.author: alice
comments.text: The name argument is every naming meeting I have ever been in.

keepers-of-the-clock.title: Keepers of the Clock
keepers-of-the-clock.description: A year with the three people who maintain the last hand-wound clock tower in the county. Documentary. 88 min. TV-G.

comments.author: carol
comments.text: Watched this after a release week and it fixed something in me.

ice-road-north.title: Ice Road North
ice-road-north.description: Docuseries. Truckers on the seasonal ice road, one winter, one convoy. Episode 1: "First Crossing". 44 min. TV-PG.

comments.author: bob
comments.text: the ice cracking audio is unreal

the-ferry-year.title: The Ferry Year
the-ferry-year.description: One ferry, one crew, four seasons on a Norwegian fjord. Documentary. 71 min. TV-G.

comments.author: alice
comments.text: The maintenance scenes are a masterclass in showing work.

the-last-shift-feature.title: The Last Shift
the-last-shift-feature.description: A night baker closes the shop for the final time and finds she cannot leave the ovens. Drama. 96 min. PG-13.

comments.author: bob
comments.text: the short was great, the feature is better

harbour-lights-feature.title: Harbour Lights
harbour-lights-feature.description: Two ferry workers on the last crossing of the year decide, separately, not to come back. Drama. 104 min. PG-13.

comments.author: carol
comments.text: quiet and devastating, in that order

the-corridor-feature.title: The Corridor
the-corridor-feature.description: A hospital night shift told in a single unbroken take. Thriller. 91 min. R.

comments.author: alice
comments.text: One take, ninety-one minutes. I checked for cuts. There are none.

paper-boat-feature.title: Paper Boat
paper-boat-feature.description: A boy folds a boat that keeps unfolding, and follows it down a river that keeps changing. Animated feature. 82 min. G.

comments.author: bob
comments.text: took my niece, we both cried at the waterfall

comments.author: carol
comments.text: hand-drawn, every frame. you can tell.

lantern-festival-feature.title: Lantern Festival
lantern-festival-feature.description: A grandmother and her granddaughter build one lantern a day until the festival. Animated feature. 78 min. G.

comments.author: alice
comments.text: The lantern-building montage is the best sequence of the year.

late-lines-priya.title: Priya Raman: Night Shift
late-lines-priya.description: Stand-up special. Three jobs, three stories, one pot of tea, recorded at 1am in a room that holds forty people. 58 min. TV-MA.

comments.author: carol
comments.text: the radio station bit is the hardest I have laughed this year

late-lines-marcus.title: Marcus Bell: Reset Count
late-lines-marcus.description: Stand-up special. A former speedrunner on resets, records, and the frame he never got back. 61 min. TV-14.

comments.author: bob
comments.text: "a reset is just a rollback with feelings" is going on a t-shirt

signal-lost-s1e1.title: Signal Lost S1:E1 "Beacon"
signal-lost-s1e1.description: A lighthouse keeper receives a transmission from a ship that sank forty years ago, asking for tonight's weather. 46 min. TV-14.

comments.author: alice
comments.text: A ghost story about deterministic replay. I am obsessed.

signal-lost-s1e2.title: Signal Lost S1:E2 "Checkpoint"
signal-lost-s1e2.description: An engineer restores her lab from a backup and finds the backup contains a version of her. 44 min. TV-14.

comments.author: carol
comments.text: restore from checkpoint as a horror premise, yes please

signal-lost-s1e3.title: Signal Lost S1:E3 "Latency"
signal-lost-s1e3.description: A colony ship's messages arrive twelve minutes late. Then twelve minutes early. 48 min. TV-14.

comments.author: bob
comments.text: the "twelve minutes early" reveal is a perfect cut to black

the-linemen-feature.title: The Linemen
the-linemen-feature.description: Power line crews after an ice storm, shot over eleven days with a crew of two. Documentary. 66 min. TV-PG.

comments.author: alice
comments.text: The ice on the lens is a happy accident they were right to keep.
